_comment: Which ImportYeti importer record is each brand. Picked by hand from free /company/search results (2026-11-14), because name matching alone picks wrong records (e.g. 'Apple Tree International', 'Chipotle Publishing'). query = what to search, title = the exact record to use. A brand missing here has no import records we trust, so the app shows none rather than a wrong match.
